node.statement: By lem-extcb-four-corner-merge applied to the supplied amplified four-corner datum and the preceding smallness bound, there is a bijective map v:B_U oplus B_V->A_R which is an extended delta-isomorphism for delta:=C_merge*(rho+epsilon_{A_R}); it satisfies delta<=M*t. By def-extended-delta-inclusion, increasing a nonnegative defect parameter only relaxes the homomorphism and two-sided norm inequalities, so M<=D_3 makes this same v an extended D_3*t-isomorphism.
